Singareni Collieries Hikes Daily Coal Output Target to 1.9 Lakh Tonnes

Singareni Collieries Company Limited (SCCL) has set a new daily coal production target of 1.9 lakh tonnes. This decision aims to meet the increasing power demand. The company has instructed its staff to ramp up production to achieve this goal.
